svg.text: A KDE Plasma 6 rice for my Fedora machine, in the same cassette palette as
this page: amber CRT in dark mode, warm beige in light mode. Two color
schemes, two Global Theme packages that switch colors, wallpaper, icons and
cursor in one go, a Konsole profile, Space Mono and VT323, a thin top bar with
an audio visualizer, and a couple of QML widgets I wrote, a date readout that
themes itself and a slow wireframe globe. One install.sh, no root needed. The
wallpapers are third party images from Wallhaven, so check their sources
